lokasi: a small Indonesian corner shop (warung) near home in the afternoon: a wooden counter with glass jars of snacks, hanging snack sachets, a small cash tray, a narrow street behind.

youtube.title: Kembalian Jajan Kelebihan | Uwais Hijrah #4
youtube.description:
Kembalian jajan kelebihan lima ribu. Diam saja atau dikembalikan?

Siapa menipu, ia bukan golongan kami. (HR. Muslim 102)

Hari 4 dari 30.

#30HariUwaisHijrah #JOTA #shorts

shots.title: Too much change
shots.figuran: SHOPKEEPER: only the hand and plain grey sleeve of a man behind the counter, his head and body outside the frame
shots.adegan: Uwais stands at the warung counter on the right holding a snack bag and counting coins and a banknote in his open palm; little Ubaid stands on his left, his head at Uwais's waist, holding a lollipop. Both face the counter at a front three-quarter angle, fully visible.
shots.gerak: Uwais counts the money in his palm slowly, stops, and tilts his head. Ubaid tugs gently at Uwais's sleeve.
shots.akhir: Uwais holds the money in his open palm, Ubaid beside him on the left.
shots.suara: Street traffic far away, a plastic bag rustling, coins clinking.
shots.latar: A small Indonesian street shop in the afternoon: plastic snack wrappers rustling, coins clinking on a wooden counter, a motorbike passing far away, sparrows chirping.

shots.title: Giving it back
shots.figuran: SHOPKEEPER: only the hand and plain grey sleeve of a man behind the counter, his head and body outside the frame

dialog.text: [firm] Bukan hak kita, Ubaid. Balikin, ya.

shots.adegan: Uwais and Ubaid stand at the counter, Ubaid on the left.
shots.gerak: Uwais places the extra banknote on the counter and slides it toward the shopkeeper's hand, which takes it. Ubaid nods and claps his small hands once.
shots.akhir: Uwais and Ubaid stand at the counter, the shopkeeper's hand withdrawn.
shots.suara: Paper sliding on wood, coins clinking, street sounds.
shots.latar: A small Indonesian street shop in the afternoon: a banknote sliding on wood, coins clinking, distant street traffic, sparrows chirping.

shots.title: Quiet warung
shots.narration: [calm] Siapa menipu, ia bukan golongan kami. HR. Muslim.
shots.adegan: The empty warung counter with the cash tray, a few coins and glass jars of colorful snacks in warm afternoon light.
shots.gerak: The afternoon light shifts softly over the jars; the camera slowly glides toward the cash tray.
shots.suara: A quiet street, a soft breeze, birds.
shots.latar: A quiet shop counter in the afternoon: a soft breeze, wind chimes, distant children playing, birds.

shots.title: Walking home
shots.lokasi: a quiet Indonesian residential lane in the late afternoon, small houses with potted plants, warm golden light.
shots.adegan: Uwais walks on the right holding a snack bag, little Ubaid walks on the left holding Uwais's hand, Ubaid's head at Uwais's waist. Both walk side by side toward the camera, fully visible.
shots.gerak: Uwais and Ubaid walk slowly hand in hand along the lane; Ubaid swings their joined hands gently.
shots.akhir: Both walk side by side, hand in hand.
shots.suara: Footsteps on the lane, birds, a distant motorbike.
shots.latar: A quiet residential lane in the late afternoon: footsteps on pavement, birds, a distant call of a street vendor, a light breeze.
